name: Boyfriend Makeover
steps: Drag the girl’s smartphone to start a live stream and expose the rude passenger.
Drag the fire extinguisher onto the man to put out his cigarette.
Tap the sprinkler above the man to spray water on him.
Drag the train conductor to the man to reprimand him.
Use the scissors to cut the man’s reclined seat so it moves back into place.
Drag the packing tape onto the man to tie him up.
Take the red emergency hammer from the wall and smash the window next to him.
Drag the man’s phone out through the broken window.
Drag the girl’s foot toward the rude man to give him a flying kick.
